title: August Robotics, which makes autonomous robots for construction and industrial applications, raised $30M led by Big Pi Ventures (Kyt Dotson/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Kyt Dotson / SiliconANGLE: August Robotics, which makes autonomous robots for construction and industrial applications, raised $30M led by Big Pi Ventures — August Robotics Ltd., a robotics automation company for construction and industrial applications, today announced it raised $30 million in new funding led by Big Pi Ventures.
